title: Key rotation can erase live replacement identity security state
description: Correctness review: LinkLayer rotation and ReplayProtector reset unconditionally delete both old and replacement identity state. If the replacement identity is already known or active, rotation destroys its replay floor and SCHC lease, allowing replay and cross-session state loss. Atomically reject an occupied replacement identity (including pinned key, replay state, session, or prepared capability), or implement authenticated migration without clearing unrelated live state. Add an accepted-new-key-then-collision/replay regression.
